name: softicon-splat-viewer
description: Gaussian splat and 3D scan viewer block for WordPress: orientation, camera and hotspots set in the block editor

scripts.zip:
rm -f softicon-splat-viewer.zip && printf '→ Building block
' && (npm run -s build >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run build) && printf '→ Translations
' && (npm run -s i18n-pot >/dev/null 2>&1 || npm run i18n-pot) && npm run -s find-ds && printf '→ Zipping
' && cd .. && zip -rq softicon-splat-viewer/softicon-splat-viewer.zip softicon-splat-viewer/softicon-splat-viewer.php softicon-splat-viewer/index.php softicon-splat-viewer/includes softicon-splat-viewer/src softicon-splat-viewer/build softicon-splat-viewer/languages softicon-splat-viewer/readme.txt softicon-splat-viewer/licenses softicon-splat-viewer/package.json softicon-splat-viewer/package-lock.json softicon-splat-viewer/webpack.config.js -x '*/.DS_Store' '*.map' 'softicon-splat-viewer/src/render.php'
scripts.postzip:
printf '
✔ Zip ready: %s
  %s files, %s

' "$PWD/softicon-splat-viewer.zip" "$(unzip -l softicon-splat-viewer.zip | tail -1 | awk '{print $2}')" "$(du -h softicon-splat-viewer.zip | cut -f1 | tr -d ' ')"
scripts.bundle: npm run lint && npm run zip
